LOCKHEED LANDER

Fly any of six Lockheed Martin aircraft. Dodge obstacles and aircraft. Land each one to unlock the SR-71. 2026 JReeves / Suttonware

UPDATE / PATCH NOTES
Choose a plane and start your flight.

Click the game to climb, or tap it on a phone. Each click or tap gives one lift. During the final approach, reach the runway marker at a safe height and a gentle vertical speed. A successful landing unlocks one new paint scheme for that aircraft. Land the C-130, F-35, C-5, Black Hawk, F-16, and F-22 once each to unlock the SR-71. Progress is saved in this browser. 2026 JReeves / Suttonware
